# Messeri & Associates, LLC

> Licensed Florida public insurance adjusting firm led by David Messeri. We represent policyholders (homeowners, commercial property owners, and associations), not insurance companies, on hurricane, wind, flood, water, fire, and other property insurance claims statewide. Bilingual service in English and French.

Key facts:
- Florida Public Adjusting Firm License #G187726; David Messeri, Florida Licensed Public Insurance Adjuster #W602412; WIND Certified Appraiser
- Office: 2660 NE 192nd Terr, Miami, FL 33180. Phone: (305) 494-5820. Email: david@messeriassociates.com
- Service area: all of Florida, including Miami, Fort Lauderdale, West Palm Beach, Naples, Tampa, Orlando, and Pensacola
- Free initial claim review with no obligation. Fees are governed by Florida law and explained in writing before any engagement
- Languages: English and French (Nous parlons français)

## Current storm: Hurricane Isaias (October 2026)

- [Hurricane Isaias insurance claim help](https://messeriassociates.com/hurricane-isaias-claim-help): free claim review and step-by-step guidance for Florida Panhandle property owners from Pensacola to Panama City (Escambia, Santa Rosa, Okaloosa, Walton, and Bay counties)
- [Pensacola storm damage claim review](https://messeriassociates.com/pensacola-storm-claim-review): storm claim review for Pensacola, Pensacola Beach, Perdido Key, and surrounding communities
